process.title: How a project runs
process.lede: No 50-page proposals. We re-skin a working demo to your brand, hook up real data, and hand over the keys.

steps.title: Pick a demo
steps.body: Choose the system closest to what you need. Preview it live, share with your team.

steps.title: Brief us in 20 min
steps.body: We meet on a call, you tell us your brand, your data, and your must-haves.

steps.title: We tailor it
steps.body: Colors, copy, integrations, domains. You watch the staging site grow daily.

steps.title: Launch & support
steps.body: We ship to your domain, train your team, and keep the lights on for 60 days free.

features.title: What you get with every project

items.title: Your domain, your data
items.body: Everything runs under your name. No vendor lock, no shared tenants.

items.title: Multi-language ready
items.body: Built for English, Russian, and Tajik out of the box. Add more in a day.

items.title: Admin you can use
items.body: Dashboards your team will actually open, not a pile of CRUD tables.

items.title: Mobile-first
items.body: Every demo is tested on a phone before it ships. No half-broken mobile experience.

items.title: Real-time chat
items.body: Customers reach a human in seconds. Your team replies from one inbox.

items.title: Two-week lead time
items.body: Average ship from brief to launch. Faster than your last RFP cycle.

pricing.title: Straight-line pricing
